title: 移動床生物膜反應器~Moving-bed biofilm reactors
focus: 載體有效面積、生物膜傳質與攔網~Carrier area, biofilm transport and retaining screens
summary: MBBR以移動載體提供附著生物膜表面，水流、載體混合與供氧共同影響反應。學徒區分名目填充比例、受保護面積、實際活性與攔網通水。~MBBR uses moving carriers for attached biofilm; flow, carrier mixing and oxygen jointly affect reaction. Distinguish fill fraction, protected area, actual activity and retaining-screen hydraulics.

units.title: 可生物降解進料：污染負荷與採樣邊界~Biodegradable feed: Pollutant load and sampling boundary
units.mechanism: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「可生物降解進料」觀察此因果關係。~Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at biodegradable feed.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
units.verify: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「可生物降解進料」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for biodegradable feed; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 濃度較低就表示污染質量一定較少。~Lower concentration necessarily means less pollutant mass.
units.practice: 先點選「可生物降解進料」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把流量改成1500 m³/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 270 kg/d。與基準 216 kg/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the biodegradable feed measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only flow to1500 m³/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 270 kg/d. Compare with baseline 216 kg/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 移動床有效反應容積：水力停留時間~Moving-bed effective volume: Hydraulic retention time
units.mechanism: 名目停留時間 V/Q 是容積周轉時間；短流與死區會使實際停留時間分布偏離此平均值。本單元在「移動床有效反應容積」觀察此因果關係。~Nominal retention V/Q is a volume turnover time; short-circuiting and dead zones distort the actual residence-time distribution. Examine this relationship at moving-bed effective volume.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：有效容積 V=800 m³、流量 Q=2400 m³/d。公式 t=24V/Q；代入 24*800/2400 = 8 h。適用邊界：有效容積不含不可用空間；不代表所有水團均停留同樣久。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: effective volume V=800 m³ and flow Q=2400 m³/d. Formula t=24V/Q; substitution 24*800/2400 = 8 h. Boundary: Effective volume excludes unusable space; not every parcel remains for the same duration.
units.verify: 用示蹤突破曲線比較平均停留與最早突破，保留流量紀錄。在離線場景為「移動床有效反應容積」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Compare tracer mean residence and early breakthrough while retaining flow records. Build an offline evidence table for moving-bed effective volume; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 隔板破損可能造成短流；擴大容積未必能消除捷徑。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~A broken baffle may create short-circuiting; a larger volume need not remove the shortcut. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: V/Q 就是每一滴水的精確停留時間。~V/Q is the exact residence time of every drop.
units.practice: 先點選「移動床有效反應容積」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把有效容積改成600 m³，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 6 h。與基準 8 h比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the moving-bed effective volume measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only effective volume to600 m³ with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 6 h. Compare with baseline 8 h and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 載體受保護面積：載體保護面積與填充率~Protected carrier area: Carrier protected area and fill fraction
units.mechanism: MBBR有效面積由反應槽容積、載體填充率及載體保護比表面積相乘；不能把槽壁面積當生物膜面積。本單元在「載體受保護面積」觀察此因果關係。~MBBR area is reactor volume times carrier fill and protected specific area; reactor-wall area is not the biofilm area. Examine this relationship at protected carrier area.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：槽容V=100 m³、填充f=0.50、載體保護面積a=400 m²/m³載體。公式 A=Vfa；代入 100*0.50*400 = 20000 m²。適用邊界：假想幾何值，實際可用生物面積仍受堵塞與膜厚影響。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: reactorV=100 m³, fillf=0.50 and protected areaa=400 m²/m³ carrier. Formula A=Vfa; substitution 100*0.50*400 = 20000 m². Boundary: Hypothetical geometry; usable biological area also depends on clogging and film thickness.
units.verify: 依載體資料確認面積定義，盤點裝填量並觀察是否均勻翻動。在離線場景為「載體受保護面積」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Check the area definition in carrier data, inventory media and observe uniform movement. Build an offline evidence table for protected carrier area; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 過高填充可能降低混合並增加攔網負擔。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Excess fill can reduce mixing and overload retention screens. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 填充越滿就一定能無限制提高處理能力。~More fill increases treatment capacity without limit.
units.practice: 先點選「載體受保護面積」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把填充f降成0.40，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 16000 m²。與基準 20000 m²比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the protected carrier area measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only fillf to0.40 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 16000 m². Compare with baseline 20000 m² and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 單位附著面積負荷：生物膜表面負荷~Attached-area loading: Biofilm surface loading
units.mechanism: 附著生長系統以每天負荷除以可用面積評估負擔；有機物與氨氮必須分開計算。本單元在「單位附著面積負荷」觀察此因果關係。~Attached-growth loading is daily load divided by usable area; organic matter and ammonia must be accounted for separately. Examine this relationship at attached-area loading.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：有機負荷60 kg/d、可用生物面積20000 m²。公式 LA=1000L/A；代入 1000*60/20000 = 3 g/(m²·d)。適用邊界：假想平均表面負荷，未計溫度、氧限制與生物膜動力學。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: organic load60 kg/d and usable biological area20000 m². Formula LA=1000L/A; substitution 1000*60/20000 = 3 g/(m²·d). Boundary: Hypothetical mean surface load; temperature, oxygen limitation and kinetics excluded.
units.verify: 量測進出水負荷並將其與載體面積和水溫一起報告。在離線場景為「單位附著面積負荷」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Measure influent/effluent loads and report them alongside carrier area and water temperature. Build an offline evidence table for attached-area loading; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 外層異營菌搶氧可使同面積硝化能力下降。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Outer heterotrophs can consume oxygen and reduce nitrification at the same area. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 所有污染物都可用同一表面負荷限值處理。~One surface-loading limit applies to every pollutant.
units.practice: 先點選「單位附著面積負荷」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把有機負荷改成90 kg/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 4.5 g/(m²·d)。與基準 3 g/(m²·d)比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the attached-area loading measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only organic load to90 kg/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 4.5 g/(m²·d). Compare with baseline 3 g/(m²·d) and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 膜厚與傳質路徑：生物膜擴散距離~Film thickness/transport path: Biofilm diffusion length
units.mechanism: 擴散特徵時間與膜厚平方成正比；生物膜加厚會增加質傳時間，不必然增加有效反應量。本單元在「膜厚與傳質路徑」觀察此因果關係。~Characteristic diffusion time scales with thickness squared; a thicker film lengthens transport and need not increase effective reaction. Examine this relationship at film thickness/transport path.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：膜厚L=0.0005 m、有效擴散係數D=1e-9 m²/s。公式 tdiff=L²/D；代入 0.0005**2/1e-9 = 250 s。適用邊界：無反應的量級估計；反應—擴散與孔隙結構需更完整模型。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: film thicknessL=0.0005 m and effective diffusivityD=1e-9 m²/s. Formula tdiff=L²/D; substitution 0.0005**2/1e-9 = 250 s. Boundary: Nonreactive timescale estimate; reaction-diffusion and porosity need a fuller model.
units.verify: 比較膜厚、溶氧剖面與表面負荷，不能僅稱量載體。在離線場景為「膜厚與傳質路徑」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Compare thickness, oxygen profiles and surface loading rather than carrier mass alone. Build an offline evidence table for film thickness/transport path; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 厚膜內層缺氧與脫落會讓出水SS升高。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Oxygen-poor thick inner layers and sloughing can raise effluent SS. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 生物膜厚度加倍就必定處理量加倍。~Doubling biofilm thickness necessarily doubles treatment.
units.practice: 先點選「膜厚與傳質路徑」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把膜厚減成0.00025 m，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 62.5 s。與基準 250 s比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the film thickness/transport path measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only film thickness to0.00025 m with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 62.5 s. Compare with baseline 250 s and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 混合與需氧分辨：氧轉移與曝氣功率~Mixing/oxygen distinction: Oxygen transfer and aeration power
units.mechanism: 氧需求與設備供氧能力須用相同工況基準；清水標準效率不能直接當污水池中的效率。本單元在「混合與需氧分辨」觀察此因果關係。~Oxygen demand and equipment transfer capacity require the same conditions; clean-water standard efficiency is not wastewater performance. Examine this relationship at mixing/oxygen distinction.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：假想需氧量480 kg O₂/d、現場修正供氧效率1.5 kg O₂/kWh。公式 Pavg=O2/(24 Efield)；代入 480/(24*1.5) = 13.33333 kW。適用邊界：平均功率示範，未含尖峰、混合需求或備援餘度。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: hypothetical oxygen demand480 kg O₂/d and field-corrected efficiency1.5 kg O₂/kWh. Formula Pavg=O2/(24 Efield); substitution 480/(24*1.5) = 13.33333 kW. Boundary: Average-power illustration; peaks, mixing requirements and reserve margin are excluded.
units.verify: 把溶氧、尾氣與電表同步；用一段變負載試驗比較回應。在離線場景為「混合與需氧分辨」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Synchronize DO, off-gas and power data and compare responses during a changing-load trial. Build an offline evidence table for mixing/oxygen distinction; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 散氣器堵塞會提高壓力而降低氧轉移，風量增加未必有效。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Clogged diffusers can raise pressure while reducing transfer, so more airflow may be ineffective. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 把風量加倍必定使有效供氧加倍。~Doubling airflow necessarily doubles useful oxygen transfer.
units.practice: 先點選「混合與需氧分辨」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把供氧效率降成1.2 kg O₂/kWh，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 16.66667 kW。與基準 13.33333 kW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the mixing/oxygen distinction measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only transfer efficiency to1.2 kg O₂/kWh with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 16.66667 kW. Compare with baseline 13.33333 kW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 載體出口攔網：載體攔網的淨通水面積~Carrier-retaining outlet screen: Carrier-screen clear flow area
units.mechanism: 攔網需保留載體又讓水通過；開孔率與堵塞決定淨面積，並影響局部水頭損失。本單元在「載體出口攔網」觀察此因果關係。~Retention screens hold media while passing water; open fraction and blockage determine clear area and local head loss. Examine this relationship at carrier-retaining outlet screen.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：總面積2 m²、開孔率0.50、堵塞分率0.20。公式 Aclear=Agross fopen(1-fblocked)；代入 2*0.50*(1-0.20) = 0.8 m²。適用邊界：幾何估計，水頭損失需依網孔及流況另估。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: gross area2 m², open fraction0.50 and blockage fraction0.20. Formula Aclear=Agross fopen(1-fblocked); substitution 2*0.50*(1-0.20) = 0.8 m². Boundary: Geometric estimate; head loss requires aperture and flow information.
units.verify: 核對上下游水位與流量，拍攝堵塞範圍並觀察載體流失。在離線場景為「載體出口攔網」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Check upstream/downstream levels and flow, document blockage and observe media loss. Build an offline evidence table for carrier-retaining outlet screen; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 攔網破損會流失載體，堵塞則可能造成溢流。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~A damaged screen loses carriers while blockage can cause overflow. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 攔網只要總面積夠大就不受堵塞影響。~Large gross screen area makes blockage irrelevant.
units.practice: 先點選「載體出口攔網」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把堵塞分率增加到0.50，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 0.5 m²。與基準 0.8 m²比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the carrier-retaining outlet screen measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only blockage to0.50 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 0.5 m². Compare with baseline 0.8 m² and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 硝化生物膜需氧：硝化的氧需求收支~Nitrifying-film oxygen: Oxygen balance for nitrification
units.mechanism: 氨氮氧化成硝酸鹽消耗氧；以氮質量為基準的化學計量與有機碳需氧量應分別列出。本單元在「硝化生物膜需氧」觀察此因果關係。~Oxidizing ammonia nitrogen to nitrate consumes oxygen; nitrogen-based stoichiometry and carbonaceous oxygen demand must be listed separately. Examine this relationship at nitrifying-film oxygen.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：假想轉化氨氮量N=30 kg N/d、理論係數4.57 kg O₂/kg N。公式 O2=4.57N；代入 4.57*30 = 137.1 kg O₂/d。適用邊界：理論完全氧化上界計量，未扣細胞合成或考慮動力學。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: hypothetical ammonia conversionN=30 kg N/d and theoretical factor4.57 kg O₂/kg N. Formula O2=4.57N; substitution 4.57*30 = 137.1 kg O₂/d. Boundary: Theoretical complete-oxidation stoichiometry; biomass assimilation and kinetics are omitted.
units.verify: 用氨、亞硝酸與硝酸三者的氮收支核對，不只看溶氧。在離線場景為「硝化生物膜需氧」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Check a nitrogen balance using ammonia, nitrite and nitrate rather than DO alone. Build an offline evidence table for nitrifying-film oxygen; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 低溫或抑制物可使氨突破，即使供氧功率正常。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Cold conditions or inhibitors can cause ammonia breakthrough despite normal aeration power. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 有足夠氧就能保證任意溫度下完全硝化。~Enough oxygen guarantees complete nitrification at any temperature.
units.practice: 先點選「硝化生物膜需氧」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把氨氮量改成40 kg N/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 182.8 kg O₂/d。與基準 137.1 kg O₂/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the nitrifying-film oxygen measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only ammonia load to40 kg N/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 182.8 kg O₂/d. Compare with baseline 137.1 kg O₂/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 水相轉化與脫落固體：去除效率與質量去向~Conversion/detached solids: Removal efficiency and mass destination
units.mechanism: 去除是污染物由水相移到污泥或被轉化；以相同流量比較濃度可估效率，但不能省略副產物流。本單元在「水相轉化與脫落固體」觀察此因果關係。~Removal moves pollutants from water to solids or transforms them; concentration comparison estimates efficiency at equal flows but does not eliminate residual streams. Examine this relationship at conversion/detached solids.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Cin=200 mg/L、Cout=40 mg/L且進出水量相同。公式 η=100(Cin-Cout)/Cin；代入 100*(200-40)/200 = 80 %。適用邊界：只適用同一物種、同時窗且等流量；不能代替總污染收支。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Cin=200 mg/L and Cout=40 mg/L at equal inlet and outlet flows. Formula η=100(Cin-Cout)/Cin; substitution 100*(200-40)/200 = 80 %. Boundary: Same species, time window and flow only; not a replacement for a complete pollutant balance.
units.verify: 同時量測污泥固體量與水相濃度，對照移除質量。在離線場景為「水相轉化與脫落固體」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Measure sludge solids and water concentrations together to reconcile removed mass. Build an offline evidence table for conversion/detached solids; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 以清水稀釋取代處理會讓濃度變低但不一定減少排放質量。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Dilution can lower concentration without lowering discharge mass. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 看不到的污染物代表已完全被破壞。~An invisible pollutant has been completely destroyed.
units.practice: 先點選「水相轉化與脫落固體」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把出水改成60 mg/L，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 70 %。與基準 80 %比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the conversion/detached solids measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only effluent to60 mg/L with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 70 %. Compare with baseline 80 % and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 後段固液分離：表面溢流率與沉降分離~Downstream solids separation: Surface loading and settling separation
units.mechanism: 理想沉澱中顆粒沉速相對於表面溢流率決定是否捕集；增加深度主要改變停留與污泥儲存，不能取代表面積。本單元在「後段固液分離」觀察此因果關係。~In ideal settling, particle settling speed relative to surface overflow rate governs capture; greater depth changes retention and sludge storage but cannot replace surface area. Examine this relationship at downstream solids separation.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=6000 m³/d、表面積 A=300 m²。公式 v0=Q/A；代入 6000/300 = 20 m/d。適用邊界：理想離散顆粒近似；絮凝、污泥濃縮、風與短流另行檢核。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=6000 m³/d and surface area A=300 m². Formula v0=Q/A; substitution 6000/300 = 20 m/d. Boundary: Ideal discrete-particle approximation; flocculation, thickening, wind and short-circuiting need separate checks.
units.verify: 用沉降柱與進出水SS比對捕集，不把水清澈當溶解物已去除。在離線場景為「後段固液分離」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Compare a settling-column test and inlet/outlet SS; clear water does not prove dissolved contaminants were removed. Build an offline evidence table for downstream solids separation; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 排泥不良會讓泥層抬升，造成出水固體增加。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Poor sludge withdrawal raises the sludge blanket and increases effluent solids. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 只要把池挖深就能任意增加沉澱流量。~Making a tank deeper permits unlimited settling flow.
units.practice: 先點選「後段固液分離」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把面積加至400 m²，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15 m/d。與基準 20 m/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the downstream solids separation measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only area to400 m² with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15 m/d. Compare with baseline 20 m/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.
